findings: components: 口 is described as depicting the mouth in one proposal, but its roles include “unknown” and the account gives it no role in the competing 牛/壴 analyses. Remove “unknown” or clarify the role array so it reflects only supported roles; “pictorial” is the supported role in the tongue-and-mouth analysis, with the relationship disputed in the edge.

learner.overview: The disputed construction is explained, but it omits that 告 is used for telling and reporting, the central current meanings needed for a first-reading layer. Add those meanings while retaining the concise construction explanation.
